definitions.gloss: house-sitting; looking after the house while others are away
definitions.explanation: Staying at home to watch over the house or office while others are out. Also refers to the person who stays behind. Composed of 留守 (absence from home) + 番 (watch/guard).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{留守番|るすばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{留守番|るすばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about leaving the children home alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}っている→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{留守番|るすばん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: While my family is on vacation, I'm staying home with the dog.

notes:
USAGE:
{留守番|るすばん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to stay home and look after things while others are away. When used about children, it often implies they are home alone (⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{留守番|るすばん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留守番|るすばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to house-sit)
- {留守番|るすばん}{電話|でんわ} (answering machine — lit. 'absence-watching phone')
- お{留守番|るすばん} (house-sitting — polite/cute form, often used with children)
- {留守番|るすばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask someone to watch the house)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧ means being away from home, while {留守番|るすばん} is the act of staying behind to watch over things during that absence.
